resources.string: Optional. On the Remote phone, PCL notices when you tap a call button in WhatsApp and tells the Gateway phone. On the Gateway phone, PCL tries to switch the Wi-Fi hotspot in Android Settings for that call, and only while it is doing so. It also starts a WhatsApp call you ask for from the Remote: it opens WhatsApp and, when needed, taps the call button in that contact\'s chat. PCL never reads, answers or rejects calls through this service.
